description: This file provides API helper functions for a frontend application to interact with a backend service. It includes functions to list, retrieve, and manipulate subjects, modules, lessons, activities, and user progress data via RESTful endpoints. It handles response parsing, normalization of data shapes, and constructs API requests with query parameters.

methods.name: handleResponse(res)
methods.description: Handles HTTP response, parses JSON or fallback to text, throws error if response not ok, returns structured response data.

methods.name: listSubjects({ search, page = 1, page_size = 20 } = {})
methods.description: Fetches a paginated list of subjects with optional search filter.

methods.name: getSubject(subjectId, { include_nested = false } = {})
methods.description: Retrieves a specific subject by ID, optionally including nested modules.

methods.name: listModulesBySubject(subjectId, { search, page = 1, page_size = 20 } = {})
methods.description: Lists modules associated with a specific subject, supports pagination and search.

methods.name: listModules({ subject_id, search, page = 1, page_size = 20 } = {})
methods.description: Lists modules with optional subject filter and pagination.

methods.name: getModule(moduleId, { include_nested = false } = {})
methods.description: Retrieves a specific module, optionally including nested lessons.

methods.name: listLessonsByModule(moduleId, { search, page = 1, page_size = 20 } = {})
methods.description: Lists lessons for a specified module, supports pagination and search.

methods.name: getLesson(lessonId, { include_nested = false } = {})
methods.description: Fetches detailed information about a lesson, with option to include nested activities.

methods.name: listActivitiesByLesson(lessonId, { page = 1, page_size = 20 } = {})
methods.description: Lists activities belonging to a lesson, supports pagination.

methods.name: getUserProgress
methods.description: Retrieves aggregated progress data for a user.

methods.name: getLessonProgressForUser
methods.description: Fetches all progress entries for a specific user and lesson.

methods.name: markLessonComplete
methods.description: Marks a lesson as completed for a user, with optional score.

methods.name: LessonIdToNumber
methods.description: Converts an ID to number if possible, for backend compatibility.

ctags.pattern: /^export async function listModulesBySubject(subjectId, { search, page = 1, page_size = 20 } = {})/

ctags.pattern: /^export async function listSubjects({ search, page = 1, page_size = 20 } = {}) {$/
